start.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Voice in the Wilderness
start.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] John cries by the Jordan:
"Repent, the Kingdom is near."

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] He speaks the word of God.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Honor the Prophet
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He is the voice prepared by God.
Lisen humbly.

turn_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Stay at the River
turn_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Your hour begins here.
The Father has called you.

crowds.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Among the People
crowds.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Crowds gather along the shore.
They come to be cleansed.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You came to be among them.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Walk among them as a brother
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You move quietly through the crowd.

apart_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Walk With Them
apart_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You came to share their humanity.
Walk among them.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Walk among them as a brother

approach.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Toward John
approach.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] John stands in the river.
His eyes find yours.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Be Humble
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You did not come to be honored.
You came to obey.

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Hour Has Come
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The Father waits for this moment.
Go to John.

hesitate.title: [TODO:pt-BR] John's Hesitation
hesitate.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] John whispers:
"I should be baptized by You."

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] "Let it be so to fulfill all."

agree_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Fulfill the Way
agree_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] This must be done in obedience.
Speak the word.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] "Let it be so to fulfill all."

rebuke_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Speak Gently
rebuke_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He is your forerunner.
Answer him with peace.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] "Let it be so to fulfill all."

baptism.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Into the Water
baptism.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The cool river rises.
You bow your head.

resist_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Surrender
resist_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] This is the will of the Father.
Yield to the moment.

dove.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Heavens Open
dove.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The sky parts above you.
A dove descends in silence.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Lift your eyes to the Father

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Look Up
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You are the Beloved Son.
Receive the gift.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Lift your eyes to the Father

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Receive in Silence
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] This moment is sacred.
Let the Spirit speak.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Lift your eyes to the Father

voice.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Father's Voice
voice.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] "This is My beloved Son,
in whom I am well pleased."
